recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-19693 unless Pharmacy reopens the broader MedicationDispense.receiver target list.
issue_request: FHIR-19693 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request to add RelatedPerson to MedicationDispense.receiver so a family member or similar related person can be recorded as picking up a medication.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites applied commit aa42e5dcc1e780bf1fa001dc784d2801f6d3b1d4. That merge includes implementation commit 9d4a0fe09370e2b75ede4debcff124f36c3d3d7e, which changed the old MedicationDispense spreadsheet receiver type from Reference(Patient|Practitioner) to Reference(Patient|Practitioner | RelatedPerson | Location).
additional_context: MedicationDispense is active and approved in source/fhir.ini. Later receiver-family decisions added or considered other target types without removing RelatedPerson: FHIR-19698 added PractitionerRole, FHIR-50109 added Organization, FHIR-42843 rejected Person while affirming RelatedPerson, and FHIR-20209 is already audited as the duplicate RelatedPerson request.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/medicationdispense/structuredefinition-MedicationDispense.xml already lists RelatedPerson among the MedicationDispense.receiver target profiles, and the search parameter source only indexes the reference element.

related_jiras.note: Duplicate later Published request to add RelatedPerson to MedicationDispense.receiver; already audited on the combined branch.
Same 2019 implementation family added Location to MedicationDispense.receiver after deciding not to add Organization/HealthcareService at that time; already audited on the combined branch.
Later Published receiver-family decision added PractitionerRole and contains comments supporting RelatedPerson for parents/spouses; already audited on the combined branch.
Later Resolved - No Change request for Person affirmed RelatedPerson as the appropriate receiver representation for someone other than the patient or practitioner.
Later Applied R6 decision added Organization and updated the receiver definition without disturbing RelatedPerson; already audited on the combined branch.
